title: Pots of Woad Blue on Order
summary: Hamo Loomis says Flora Pickering has an order for 2 pots of woad blue that cannot wait. The stock is at the dye works, and the deadline is before the guild inspector arrives.
offer_text: "Flora Pickering has an order and nobody to fetch it. Hear Flora out, then bring the goods from the dye works before the guild inspector arrives. I will vouch for you."

objectives.text: Take 2 pots of woad blue from the dye works
Hand the pots of woad blue to Flora Pickering
